definitions.explanation: In baseball, the outfielder who covers left field, positioned to the left of center field as seen from home plate.

examples.japanese: {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: The left fielder catches a fly ball.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{打撃|だげき}→打撃：12775_dageki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: This left fielder is also good at hitting.

examples.japanese: {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦フェンス→フェンス：26996_fensu⟧{際|ぎわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捕|と}らえた。
examples.english: The left fielder caught the ball right at the fence.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{左翼|さよく}→左翼：22746_sayoku⟧ (left wing) + {手|しゅ} (player). The outfielder who covers left field. Colloquially called レフト.

RELATED POSITIONS:
- ⟦{右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}→右翼手：29929_uyokushu⟧: right fielder
- ⟦{中堅|ちゅうけん}{手|しゅ}→中堅手：29928_chuukenshu⟧: center fielder

As with ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧, ⟦{左翼|さよく}→左翼：22746_sayoku⟧ alone often refers to the political left wing; {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ} is specifically the baseball position.
